summary: Sub-phase 20.2 landed two of its four obligations and REFUTED the third. Landed: a truth lemma for the embedded model standing only on the family's own four certification conditions (Sound.lean's own truth lemma cannot serve -- it hypothesises exactly what an embedded certificate must establish), and from it SlabTrue (hst) and the canonical-label identification (hcan). Refuted: the BACKWARD conjunct of PlusSlicedCertificate.TailStable is FALSE at an embedded certificate built from a certifying WitnessFamily, by kernel-checked decide at two separate families, at residue r = 0 -- the pre-residue demand itself, not an artifact of the residue indexing -- while the forward conjunct holds at both. Sub-phase 20.1's favourable probe missed it because both of its certificates carry an untl closure and no snce, and the two conjuncts are not symmetric: the forward one carries the option-2 liveness filter and the backward one carries none. The flagship depends on the refuted demand and is blocked. Per the plan's Fallback bullet no repair was chosen; one candidate (the exact mirror filter) is measured clean at all four certificates and named as a candidate only, with TailStable unchanged. Full lake build green at 2805 jobs, zero errors, zero warnings, zero sorries, axiom count 14 unchanged.

artifacts.summary: Round-05 implementation summary, extended with the dispatch-49 record: the embedded model's truth lemma, hcan, SlabTrue, and the refutation of TailStable's backward conjunct.

Phase 20 BLOCKED handoff: the refutation and its mechanism, why 20.1's untl-only probe missed it, the candidate repair's four measured verdicts, the right-tail-only correction to the fwdLiveAt asymmetry justification, and the three options for the ruling.

blockers.verbatim_goal: Prove exists_plusSlicedCertificate_of_not_plusValidZTime_ofFormula -- every Z-time non-validity of L, transported to L-plus, has a sliced certificate.
blockers.what_was_tried: Complete.lean's exists_plusSlicedCertificate_of_tailStable_countermodel leaves four hypotheses outstanding at the embedded certificate: hTS, hst, hcan, hconc. hst and hcan were proved (sliced_slabTrue, sliced_target_lab_eq_canLab), via a new truth lemma sliced_plusTruthAt_iff_mem for the embedded model that consumes only W.LocalCoherentLab, W.FulfillingLab and W.BoxFaithful. hTS was then attacked, starting from the plan's mandated PROBE-FIRST discipline: a probe of TailStable was built at a certifying family whose target carries a snce rather than an untl -- the one shape sub-phase 20.1's two favourable certificates do not cover.
blockers.why_it_failed: The backward conjunct is FALSE, not merely hard. snceClauseAt constrains the LATER label from the earlier, so a position whose label carries a snce obligation no admissible predecessor can discharge is a legitimate member of posAt with empty predP -- not backward-live, hence not live -- while its succP is non-empty. stepBack is a succP-preimage, so that position lands in iterBack, and the backward conjunct, unlike the forward one, carries no liveness filter to remove it. Landed as snceProbeFamily_not_tailStableBack and snceProbeLiveFamily_not_tailStableBack, at residue r = 0 (NBnat = 1), at two families whose Certifies verdicts are also landed. The refuting family additionally satisfies every output condition of exists_witnessFamily_of_not_validZTime besides its own target's invalidity (snceProbeFamily_segment_bounds, _lasso_count, _bx_shape, _target_time), so reading more of that theorem's conclusion does not dodge the obstruction. A USER RULING is required: the demand must be repaired, the compression theorem's output strengthened, or the route changed.

next_action_hint: Do NOT open 20.2's remaining work. Put the user_decision on .return-meta.json to the user and resume only once the ruling lands. If the mirror filter is chosen, the redo list is named in the handoff and in the summary's Follow-ups.

user_decision.question: The backward conjunct of PlusSlicedCertificate.TailStable is refuted at an embedded certificate built from a certifying WitnessFamily (kernel-checked, residue r = 0, two separate families), so the flagship cannot be assembled along the planned route. The forward conjunct already carries a liveness filter from your option-2 ruling at sub-phase 16.3; the backward one carries none, and that is the gap. How should this be repaired?
options: Mirror the filter: replace the backward conjunct by TailStableMirror, filtering by the computed backward-live set bwdLiveAtCand. Measured clean at all four certificates (repairs both refuting ones, regresses neither of sub-phase 20.1's). Accepted cost: every result stated from the backward conjunct's functional form must be redone, exactly as tailStable_iff_window_fwd was when the forward filter landed -- Stable.lean's iterBack_liveAt_refBack and iterBack_L0, Tail.lean's mem_L0_of_live_tail, live_of_mem_L0_tail, tailStable_iff_window, liveAt_tail_eq_L0, liveAt_winLo_eq_L0, and the left branch of exists_win_live_eq, which Phase 18's truth lemma consumes. The soundness lemma the redo needs is the FoldB analogue of mem_fwdLiveT_of_fwdLive_fold; Fold.lean lands every transport it requires and only a bwdVertFold counterpart of fwdVertFold is missing, so it is plausible and unproved.

Strengthen the compression theorem's output so the families it produces exclude the junk positions -- unmeasured, and it reopens WitnessFamily/Compression/Family.lean, which this task's description does not scope.
Change route: abandon Complete.lean's TailStable-hypothesised headline. Unmeasured, and since TailStable is a field of Certifies this means a different certificate notion, i.e. most of Stage 2 again.
Record the failure as a stated limitation of the Stage 2 result and stop short of the flagship, leaving the sliced class without the non-vacuity the task asks for.
